title: [FLINK-39872][e2e] Add `wrapInExecutionException` to `common.sh`
body:
## What is the purpose of the change

This is another step towards java25

## Brief change log
with java25 there is a new line apeared
```
        at java.base/java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture.wrapInExecutionException(CompletableFuture.java:345)
```
which is the reason of this change

## Verifying this change

java25 e2e

I have my own azure for java25 https://dev.azure.com/snuyanzin/flink/_build/results?buildId=4901&view=results
where e2e passed
